### Features

- feat(corpus): embed operator-decisions corpus as no-filesystem fallback
- feat(connect): portable Go GitHub connector (events feed + App auth)
- feat(eval): end-to-end scan validation (-mode e2e) with detect-fidelity

- feat(core): pipeline + mallcop scan — full agentic scan end-to-end (connect->detect->cascade->store)
- feat(core/agent): deep-investigate x3 fan-out + evidence-aggregation merge + heal (false-negative catcher)

- feat(core): hard-constraint pre-LLM floor — dangerous families force-escalate, model never called (spy-proven)
- feat(core): core/tools — 4 pure investigate tools over core/store
- feat(core): core/store — git-as-DB source of truth, directives+conversation first-class, rebase-retry
- feat(core): core/detect — 13 detectors offline, mallcop detect
- feat(p0): decouple mallcop-legion from campfire + legion runtime (stub agentic scan pending core/pipeline)
- feat(100%): integrated 7-fix plan toward open-lane 100% pass (#113)

- feat(gate): triage-tier gate with recalibrated floor + force-escalate fan-out (mallcoppro-499) (#97)
- feat(triage): pattern-match escalation for auth-burst, maintenance-window, batch-volume B1 patterns (mallcoppro-276)
- feat(bakeoff): enable confidence gate + lower floor to 0.40 (mallcoppro-276) (#95)
- feat(academy): chain-shape no-triage-inference detector + fec structural-fault wire parse (mallcoppro-2f1) (#94)

- fix(test): merge-gate canned backend is content-aware (deterministic under concurrent fan-out) — kills the residual Rule-11 flake
- fix(core): race-proof corpus-root resolution (kill mid-run-clearable global) + revert grader force-escalate auto-pass (honest scoring)

- fix(core/eval): wire per-scenario live ToolRunner (real core/tools over scenario events+baseline) so ModeReal agent actually investigates
- fix(core/agent): root-cause flaky suite (shared-state) + make verdict-isolation mutation-proof, close untrusted-text verdict path
- fix(core/tools): retrofit to tool-contract checklist (fold rules into search-events, envelope, empty-as-data, self-resolving config, date fallback, case-insensitive)
- fix(handoff): thread academy scenario id through investigate chain handoffs (#119)
- fix(rawEvent): UnmarshalJSON accepts both PascalCase and snake_case keys (#118)
- fix(search-events): fall back to all-events when date filter excludes everything (#117)
